छ: छ The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed by Ch.

छ mfn. (छः-छा-छं) 1 Pure, clean. 2 Trembling, tremulous, unsteady. m. (छः) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a fragment. f. (-छा) 1 Covering, concealing. 2 An infant, a child, any young animal. E. छो to cut, or छद to cover, &c. affix ड.
छग: छग mf. (-गः-गा) A goat. E. छो to cut, गक् aff.
छगण: छगण mn. (-णः-णं) Dried cowdung. E. छ a fragment, and गण assemblage.
छगल: छगल m. (-लः) A goat. f. (-ला-ली) A she goat. 2 A kind of convolvulus (C. argenteus), or more probably (C. pes-capræ:) see ऋक्षगन्धा. n. (-लं) Blue cloth or raiment. E. छो to cut or tear, Uṇādi affixes कल and गुट्, or ग substituted for क.
छगलक: छगलक m. (-कः) A goat. E. कन् added to the preceding.
छगलाङ्घ्री: छगलाङ्घ्री f. (-ङ्घ्री) A kind of convolvulus, (C. pes-caprae:) see छगला. E. छगल a goat, and अङ्घ्रि a foot; also छगलान्त्री, &c.
छगलाण्डी: छगलाण्डी f. (-ण्डी) A plant: see the preceding.
छगलान्त्री: छगलान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A kind of convolvulus: see छगलाङ्घ्री. E. छगल a goat, and अन्त्र a gut, an entrail; with कन् added, छगलान्त्रिका; also छगलाङ्घी.
छटा: छटा f. (-टा) 1 Light, lustre, splendor. 2 Assemblage, quantity, number. 3 A straight or continuous mark or line.
छटाफल: छटाफल m. (-लः) A palmyra tree. E. छटा a line, and फल fruit.
छटाभा: छटाभा f. (-भा) Lightning. E. छटा a streak, and भा light.
छत्र: छत्र n. (-त्रं) A parasol, an umbrella, the Indian catta. f. (-त्रा) 1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 2 A pungent seed, coriander. 3 A mushroom. 4 Anise. E. छद to cover, and ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi affix; hence the word and its derivatives are also written with a double त, छत्त्र, &c.
छत्रक: छत्रक m. (-कः) A king-fisher. 2 A mushroom. 3 A shrub, commonly Kuliyā-khāra. 4 A small vaulted temple, in honour of a deity. 5 A beehive of a conical or umbrella form. E. कन् added to the preceding.
छत्रचक्र: छत्रचक्र n. (-क्रं) An astrological diagram. E. छत्र, and चक्र a circle.
छत्रधार: छत्रधार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Bearing a parasol, having or possessing one. E. छत्र, and धर who has or holds, affix अण्; also छत्रधर, छत्रधारक, and छत्रधारिन्.
छत्रधारण: छत्रधारण n. (-णं) 1 Carrying a catta. 2 The carrying of one as a type of authority. E. छत्र, and धारण having.
छत्रपत्र: छत्रपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plant, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. छत्र, and पत्र a leaf, umbrella-leaved; also छत्रपत्रक.
छत्रभङ्ग: छत्रभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Widowhood. 2 Wilfulness, independence. 3 Subversion of dominion, loss of empire, deposition, &c. E. छत a parasol, and भङ्ग a breaking; in the first two senses छत्र is used metaphorically, for any cover or defence, as a husband, &c.; in the last it is used by synecdoche, a parasol being one of the ensigns of royalty.
छत्राक: छत्राक n. (-कं) A mushroom. f. (-की) A plant, commonly Rāsnā: see रास्ना. E. छत्र a parasol, and अक to go, to resemble; affixes अण् and ङीष्.
छत्रातिच्छत्र: छत्रातिछत्र m. (-त्रः) A fragrant grass, described as growing in marshy ground. E. छत्र a mushroom, and अतिछत्र surpassing an umbrella, i. e. more like a catta, than even a mushroom.
छत्रातिछत्र: छत्रातिछत्र m. (-त्रः) A fragrant grass, described as growing in marshy ground. E. छत्र a mushroom, and अतिछत्र surpassing an umbrella, i. e. more like a catta, than even a mushroom.
छत्रिका: छत्रिका f. (-का) A mushroom. E. छत्र, कन् affix of resemblance, fem. form.
छत्रिन्: छत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Bearing a parasol or umbrella. m. (-त्री) A barber. E. छत्र, and इनि aff.
छत्वर: छत्वर m. (-रः) 1 A house, a dwelling. 2 A bower, an arbour. E. छद to cover, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त substituted for द.
छद: छद r. 1st and 10th cls. (छदति-ते and छदयति, or more commonly छादयति.) 1 To cover, to clothe, to veil, to hide, or remove from view: (आङ् is usually prefixed to the root in these senses.) 2 To march. (इ) छदि r. 1st cl. (छंदति) To live or breathe, to be or make strong; also r. 1st and 10th cls. (छन्दति छंदयति) To cover, &c. as above.
छद m. (-दः) 1 A leaf. 2 A wing. 3 A plant: see ग्रन्थिपर्णी. 4 A tree bearing dark blossoms: see तमाल. E. छद to cover, &c. aff. घ.
छदन: छदन n. (-नं) 1 A leaf. 2 A wing. 3 A covering, a sheathe, a scabbard. 4 Cassia. E. छद to cover or hide, affix युच्.
छदपत्र: छदपत्र m. (-त्रः) A tree, (Symplocos racemosa, Rox.) see भूर्य्य E. छद a cover or skin, and पत्र a leaf.
छदिस्: छदिस् m. (-दिः) The thatch or roof of a house. E. छद to cover, इसि Uṇādi aff.
छद्मतापस: छद्मतापस m. (-सः) A religious hypocrite, a false brother. E. छद्म disguise, and तापस an ascetic.
छद्मन्: छद्मन् n. (-द्मं) 1 Trick, deceit. 2 Fraud, dishonesty. 3 Plea, pretext. 4 Masquerade, disguise of person, &c. E. छद a cloak, a covering, and मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
छद्मवेशिन्: छद्मवेशिन् m. (-शी) Being in disguise, a player. E. छद्म and वेशिन् who wears a dress, &c.
छद्वर: छद्वर m. (-रः) 1 A tooth. 2 An arbour or bower.
छन्च्छन्: छन्च्छन् ind. An imitative sound, expressive of sobbing, &c.
छन्द: छन्द mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं) Solitary, secret, private. m. (-न्दः) 1 Meaning, intention, purport, opinion. 2 Subjection. 3 Poison. n. (-न्दं) Wish, desire. E. छद to cover, affix घञ्: see छन्दस्.
छन्दपातन: छन्दपातन m. (-नः) A hypocrite, a pretended and false ascetic. E. छन्द subjection, (of all human beings,) and पातन obtaining, from पत to go, affix ल्युट्; also छन्दकपातन.
छन्दस्: छन्दस् n. (-न्दः) 1 Poetical metre of every kind, but it is also applicable particularly to the metre of the Vedas. 2 Meaning, purport, object, intention. 3 Wish, desire. 4 The Vedas or scripture. 5 Wilfulness, independence, uncontrolled or unrestrained conduct. E. चदि to gladden, &c. and असुन् Uṇādi affix, च is changed to छ; also in some senses with a final vowel छन्द, q. v.
छन्दस्कृत: छन्दस्कृत n. (-तं) A holy verse. E. छन्दस्, and कृत made.
छन्दस्य: छन्दस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Made or done at will or according to one's wish. E. छन्दस् inclination, and यत् aff.
छन्दोग: छन्दोग m. (-गः) A reciter, or chanter of the Sāma Veda. E. छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and ग who sings.
छन्दोनुवृत्त: छन्दोनुवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Humouring, indulgence. E. छन्दस् will, and अनुवृत्त conforming to.
छन्न: छन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Private, secret. 2 Solitary. 3 Covered. E. छद to cover, affix क्त.
छप: छप (इ) छपि r. 1st and 10th cls. (छम्पति छम्पयति) To go or move.
छम: छम (उ) छमु r. 1st cl. (छमति) To eat: see चमु.
छमण्ड: छमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 An orphan, a fatherless son. 2 A lad who has no kinsmen. E. छम to eat, अण्डच् Uṇādi affix; also छेमण्ड.
छर्द: छर्द r. 10th cl. (छर्दयति) To vomit, to be sick.
छर्द nf. (-र्दं-र्दी) Vomiting, sickness, reaching. E. छर्द to vomit, affix अच्; also with the affixes ल्युट् and इन्, छर्दन्, छर्दि, &c. ut infra.
छर्दन: छर्दन n. (-नं) Vomiting, reaching, sickness. m. (-नः) 1 The Nimb tree: see निम्ब. 2 The Rākṣasa, ALAMBUṢA. E. कृद to be or make sick, affix ल्युट्.
छर्दि: छर्दि f. (-र्दिः) Vomiting: see छर्द. E. छृद to be sick, इन् Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added छर्दी, and with a further addition of कन्, छर्दिका.
छर्दिघ्न: छर्द्दिघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The Nimb tree. E. छर्द्दि, and घ्न what removes.
छर्द्दिघ्न: छर्द्दिघ्न m. (-घ्नः) The Nimb tree. E. छर्द्दि, and घ्न what removes.
छर्दिकारिपु: छर्दिकारिपु m. (-पुः) Small cardamoms. E. छर्दिका vomiting, and रिपु enemy, anti-emetic.
छर्दिस्: छर्दिस् f. (-र्दिः) Vomiting. E. छृद to be sick, Uṇādi affix इसि; also छर्दि and छर्द.
छर्ष: छर्ष r. 1st cl. (छर्षति-ते) To kill, to wound, to hurt.
छल: छल n. (-लं) 1 Wickedness. 2 Fraud, circumvention, trick, stratagem. 3 Design, device. E. छो to cut, कलच् affix, and the radical final rejected.
छलन: छलन nf. (-नं-ना) Tricking, deceiving. E. छल nominal verb, युच् aff.
छलनापर: छलनापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cunning, crafty, deceitful. E. छलना, and पर addicted to.
छलयत्: छलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Deceiving, cheating. E. छल nom. verb to cheat, शतृ aff.
छलिन्: छलिन् m. (-ली) A cheat. E. छल, and इनि aff.
छल्लि: छल्लि f. (-ल्लिः) Skin, bark, rind, &c. E. छद a cover, ला to give or get; with affix कि, द becomes ल; also with ङीप् added छल्ली.
छल्ली: छल्ली f. (-ल्ली) 1 Skin, bark, rind, &c. 2 Offspring, posterity. 3 A spreading creeper. 4 A kind of flower. E. see the preceding.
छवि: छवि f. (-विः) 1 Beauty, splendor, brilliance. 2 Light, lustre. E. छो to divide, (darkness, &c.) इन् affix, and the deriv. irr. or क्विन् Uṇādi affix; also with ङीष् added छवी.
छा: छा f. (छा) A young animal. E. छो to cut, डा aff.
छाग: छाग f. (-गः) A goat. f. (-गी) A she goat. E. छो to cut, Uṇādi affix गण्.
छागण: छागण m. (-णः) A fire of dried cowdung. E. अण् affix of relation, added to छगण्.
छागभोजिन्: छागभोजिन् m. (-जी) A wolf. E. छाग, and भोजिन् who eats.
छागरथ: छागरथ m. (-थः) AGNI or the deity of fire. E. छाग a goat, and रथ a car or any vehicle.
छागल: छागल m. (-लः) 1 A goat: see छगल; also with कन् added छागलक. 2 A proper name, the son of CHAGALA or ATRI. E. छगल and अण affix; also with इञ् aff. छागलि or कन् added छागलक.
छागलान्त्री: छागलान्त्री f. (-न्त्री) A plant, (Convolvulus pes-capræ:) see छगलान्त्री.
छागवाहन: छागवाहन m. (-नः) A name of AGNI or the deity of fire. E. छाग a goat, and वाहन a vehicle, the goat-borne.
छागिका: छागिका f. (-का) A she goat. E. कन् added to छागी.
छात: छात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Thin, feeble, emaciated. E. छो to cut, affix क्त; also छित.
छात्र: छात्र m. (-त्रः) A scholar, a pupil, a disciple, a tyro or novice. n. (-त्रं) Honey. E. छत्र an umbrella, a screen or cover, affix अण्.
छात्रक: छात्रक n. (-कं) Honey in the comb or hive. E. छत्रक a hive, and अण् aff.
छात्रगण्ड: छात्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) An indifferent scholar in poetical composition; one citing imperfect portions only of a verse.
छात्रदर्शन: छात्रदर्शन n. (-नं) Oiled butter prepared from milk one day old.
छाद: छाद n. (-दं) A thatch, a roof. E. छद to cover, affix घञ्.
छादन: छादन n. (-नं) 1 Covering. 2 A covering, a screen, &c. 3 Hiding, concealing. 4 A leaf. E. छद to cover, affix ल्यु, and the vowel lengthened.
छादित: छादित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut, divided. 2 Covered. 3 Hidden, concealed. E. छो to cut, or छद to cover, affix क्त.
छाद्मिक: छाद्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Fraudulent, dishonest. m. (-कः) A rogue, a cheat. E. छद्मन् knavery, ठञ् aff.
छान्दस: छान्दस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Relating to poetical metre, to the Vedas, &c. m. (-सः) A priest conversant with scripture. E. छन्दस्, and अण् aff.
छान्दोग्य: छान्दोग्य n. (-ग्यं) 1 The doctrine of the Vedas. 2 A celebrated Upaniṣad of the Sāma Veda. E. छान्दस् belonging to the Vedas, ग who goes, and क्य affix of habitude or practice.
छाया: छाया f. (-या) 1 Shade. 2 Shadow, reflected image. 3 The wife of the sun. 4 Beauty, splendor, lustre. 5 Light. 6 Nourishing, cherishing. 7 A bribe. 8 A straight or continuous line. 9 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. 10 Darkness, obscurity. 11 The shadow of a Gnomon, especially as indicative of the position of the sun. E. छो to cut, (to cut off the light, &c.) and य Uṇādi aff.
छायाकर: छायाकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Shading, shadowing. m. (-रः) 1 A catta or umbrella bearer. 2 A species of metre. E. छाया shade, and कर who makes.
छायातनय: छायातनय m. (-यः) A name of SATURN. E. छाया the wife of SŪRYA, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as छायात्मज, छायासुत, &c.
छायातरु: छायातरु m. (-रुः) A large tree, one that gives shade or shelter. E. छाया, and तरु a tree.
छायापथ: छायापथ m. (-थः) Æther, the Ākāśa or firmament. E. छाया light, and पथ a road.
छायाभृत्: छायाभृत् m. (-भृत्) CANDRA or the moon. E. छाया light, and भृत् who possesses.
छायामय: छायामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Reflected. 2 Casting a shadow. E. छाया, and मयट् aff.
छायामित्र: छायामित्र n. (-त्रं) A catta or parasol. E. छाया shade, and मित्र friendly.
छायामृगधर: छायामृगधर m. (-रः) The moon. E. छाया an image, मृग a deer, and धर who possesses; also छायाधर, and मृगधर severally.
छि: छि m. (-छिः) Abuse, reproach. E. छो to cut, कि aff.
छिक्कण: छिक्कण n. (-णं) Sneezing. f. (-णी) A small plant, (Artemisia sternutatoria). E. छिक्क nominal verb, to sneeze, ल्युट् aff.
छिक्का: छिक्का f. (-क्का) Sneezing. E. छिक् imitative sound, and क what utters, from कै with ड and टाप् affs.
छिक्कक: छिक्कक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Sternutatory. 2 Sneezing. f. (-का) A plant, (Artemisia sternutatoria.) E. छिक्क nominal verb, to sneeze, वुन् aff.
छित: छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided. E. छो to cut, affix क्त, deriv irr.
छित्ति: छित्ति m. (-त्तिः) 1 Cutting, division. 2 A plant, (Galedupa arborea:) see करज. E. छिद to cut, affix क्तिन्.
छित्त्वर: छित्त्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Roguish, fraudulent, knavish, a knave. 2 Hostile, inimical, a foe. 3 Cutting or fit for cutting, (a weapon, &c.) E. छिद to cut, स्वरच् Uṇādi affix, and त optionally substituted for the radical final, otherwise छिद्वर.
छित्त्वा: छित्त्वा ind. Having cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, क्त्वा aff.
छिद: छिद (औ, इर) औछिदिर r. 7th cl. (छिनत्ति छिंत्ते) To divided, to split, to cut, &c. With the prefix आङ्, To seize, to lay hold of. With the prefix उत, To slay or kill.
छिद्: छिद् mfn. (-द् or त्) Cutting, destroying, who or what cuts. E. छिद to cut, affix क्विप्.
छिदक: छिदक n. (-कं) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. छिद to cut or split, affix क्वन्; also छिदिक.
छिदा: छिदा f. (-दा) Cutting, dividing. E. छिद, as above, affixes अङ् and टाप्.
छिदि: छिदि f. (-दिः) An axe. E. छिद to cut, इ Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel unchanged.
छिदिर: छिदिर m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A rope, a cord. 3 A sword. 4 An axe, a hatchet. E. छिद to cut, किरच् Uṇādi aff.
छिदुर: छिदुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Cutting, dividing, what cuts or divides. 2 A knave. 3 Hostile, a foe. E. छिद to cut, and कुरच् aff.
छिद्र: छिद्र r. 10th cl. (छिद्रयति) 1 To pierce, to bore, to perforate, to make openings or holes. 2 To perforate the ear for rings, &c.
छिद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 A hole, a vacuity, a perforation, &c. 2 Fault, defect, flaw, (moral or physical.) 3 A weak side. 4 Infirmity. E. छिद to pierce, Uṇādi affix रक्.
छिद्रकर्ण: छिद्रकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears pierced. E. छिद्र, and कर्ण the ear.
छिद्रानुसारिन्: छिद्रानुसारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Looking out for faults or flaws. E. छिद्र, and अनुसारिन् who pursues.
छिद्रान्तर्: छिद्रान्तर् m. (-न्तः) A reed. E. छिद्र, and अन्तर् within.
छिद्रान्वेषिन्: छिद्रान्वेषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking for faults, malicious. E. छिद्र, and अन्वेषिन् searching.
छिद्रित: छिद्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Perforated, pierced, having holes or openings. E. छिद्र to pierce, affix क्त.
छिन्न: छिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Cut, divided. f. (-न्ना) 1 A whore, a harlot. 2 A tree: see गुडूची. E. छिद to cut, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
छिन्नक: छिन्नक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Cut a little, incised, not cut off. E. कन् added to छिन्न.
छिन्नकर्ण: छिन्नकर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णी-र्णं) Having the ears cut off. E. छिन्न, and कर्ण the ear.
छिन्नकेश: छिन्नकेश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Shorn, shaven. E. छिन्न, and केश the hair.
छिन्नधन्वन्: छिन्नधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A warrior whose bow has been cut or broken by his enemy's arrow. E. छिन्न, and धन्वन् a bow.
छिन्ननासिक: छिन्ननासिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Noseless, having had the nose cut off. E. छिन्न, and नासिका the nose.
छिन्ननास्य: छिन्ननास्य mfn. (स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Having the rope that passes through the nose of a draft ox broken. E. छिन्न, and नास्य the nose-rein.
छिन्नबन्धन: छिन्नबन्धन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Loosed, liberated. E. छिन्न, and बन्धन binding.
छिन्नभिन्न: छिन्नभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Cut up, destroyed, scattered. E. छिन्न, and भिन्न broken.
छिन्नमस्त: छिन्नमस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Decapitated. f. (-स्ता) A form of DURGĀ without her head. E. छिन्न, and मस्त the head; also with कन् added छिन्नभस्तक, छिन्नमस्तका.
छिन्नरुहा: छिन्नरुहा f. (-हा) A tree, (Menispermum glabrum:) see गुडूची. E. छिन्न cut, and रुहा what grows; growing again after being cut.
छिन्नवत्: छिन्नवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having cut or cut off. E. छिन्न, and मतुप् aff.
छिन्नवेशिका: छिन्नवेशिका f. (-का) A plant, commonly Akaindhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.) E. छिन्न what is cut, (a wound,) and विश to enter, वुन् affix, and the fem. form.
छिन्नसंशय: छिन्नसंशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Confirmed, confident, free from doubt. E. छिन्न, and संशय doubt.
छुच्छुन्दरी: छुछुन्दरी f. (-री) The musk rat or shrew.
छुछुन्दरी: छुछुन्दरी f. (-री) The musk rat or shrew.
छुट: छुट r. 6th and 10th cls. (छोटति छोटयति) To cut; also चुट्.
छुद्र: छुद्र n. (-द्रं) 1 Retaliating, returning, remedying. 2 A ray.
छुप: छुप (औ) ओछुप r. 6th cl. (छुपति) To touch.
छुप m. (-पः) 1 A small tree, a shrub, a bush. 2 Touch, touching. 3 Air, wind. 4 War, combat. E. छुप to touch, affix क.
छुरा: छुरा f. (-रा) Lime. E. छुर to cut, अङ् and टाप् affs.
छुरिका: छुरिका f. (-का) A knife. E. छुर to cut, क्वुन् affix, and the fem. form; also with क, and ङीष् affixes, छुरी.
छुरित: छुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cut. 2 Inlaid, set, coated, spread. 3 Blended, intermingled. E. छुर to cut, affix क्त.
छुरितोदर: छुरितोदर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Pierced, transpierced. 2 Run through the belly. E. छुरित, and उदर the belly.
छुरी: छुरी f. (-री) A knife: see छुरिका.
छृद: छृद (उ and इर) उछृदिर r. 7th cl. (छृणत्ति छृंत्ते) 1 To shine. 2 To vomit. 3 To play. (ई) छृदी r. 1st and 10th cls. (छर्दति छर्दयति) To light, to kindle.
छृप: छृप (ई) छृपी r. 1st and 10th cls. (छर्पति छर्पयति) To light, to inflame or kindle.
छेक: छेक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Tame, domesticated, as a bird or beast. 2 Citizen, town-bred, rakish, buckish, smart, trained in the acuteness and vice of towns. E. छो to cut, affix ईकन, deriv. irr.
छेकोक्ति: छेकोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Indirect speech, insinuation, double entendre, hint, &c. E. छेक city-bred, and उक्ति saying.
छेत्तव्य: छेत्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut, to be cut off, &c. E. छिद to cut, तव्य aff.
छेत्तृ: छेत्तृ mfn. (-त्ता-त्त्री-त्तृ) 1 Who or what cuts. 2 Solving, resolving, (doubts, &c.) E. छिद to cut, तृच् aff.
छेद: छेद r. 10th cl. (छेदयति) To cut, to cover, to divide, but especially into two parts.
छेद m. (-दः) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a portion. 3 Solving, dissipating, (as doubt.) 4 The denominator of a fraction. 5 The divisor. E. छिद to cut, affix घञ्.
छेदकर: छेदकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Cutting. m. (-रः) A wood-cutter. E. छेद, and कर who makes.
छेदन: छेदन n. (-नं) 1 Cutting, dividing. 2 A part, a portion. E. छिद to cut, affix ल्युट्.
छेदनीय: छेदनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, अनीयर् aff.
छेदि: छेदि mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि) Cutting, dividing, a cutter, &c. E. छिद to cut, Uṇādi affix इन्.
छेदित: छेदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, divided. E. छिद to cut, affix क्त.
छेदितव्य: छेदितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be cut or divided. E. छिद to cut, तव्य aff.
छेद्य: छेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) To be cut or divided. n. (-द्यं) Amputation, excision. E. छिद to cut, यत् aff.
छेमण्ड: छेमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A fatherless son: see छमण्ड.
छेलु: छेलु m. (-लुः) A medicinal plant, (Conyza anthelmintica.)
छैदिक: छैदिक m. (-कः) A ratan, a cane. E. छेद cutting, ठञ् aff.
छो: छो r. 4th cl. (छ्यति) To cut, to mow, to reap, &c.
छोटिका: छोटिका f. (-का) Snapping the thumb and fore finger together. E. छुट to touch, वुद aff.
छोटिन्: छोटिन् m. (-टी) A fisherman. E. छो to cut, उटिन् affix, deriv. irr.
छोरण: छोरण n. (-णं) Abandoning, leaving. E. छुर to cut, affix ल्युट.
छोलङ्ग: छोलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A citron, a lime.
छ्यु: छ्यु r. 1th cl. (छ्यवते) To go, to move or approach: see च्यु. ज
